verdict.rationale: Baseten's Model APIs pricing docs say you can set a workspace budget, and rate limits plus usage tracking by API key, user, model, or service tier give extra cost control. Rate-limit headers report remaining requests, so callers can see when they are nearing limits. missing for 10: confirmation of whether the budget is a hard cap that stops spend or only an alert, evidence that budgets cover dedicated GPU deployments and training jobs (not just Model APIs), detailed budget configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
